en: The Triplet of the Wholesome, the Triplet of Leading to Accumulation.

Dependent on a wholesome state leading to accumulation, a state that is neither wholesome nor leading to accumulation arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Under root condition there are six; under predominance condition there are six ... [etc. ... under non-disappearance condition there are six.

Dependent on a wholesome state leading to diminution, a state that is neither wholesome nor leading to diminution arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Under root condition there are three; under predominance condition there are three ... [etc. ... under non-disappearance condition there are three.

Conditioned by an indeterminate state that leads neither to accumulation nor to dispersal, there arises an indeterminate state that leads neither to accumulation nor to dispersal by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. There are five [conditions] under root; ... pe ... five under non-disappearance.
